title: Maryland Manual 1912-13 (Archives of Maryland vol. 123), election returns (general election 1912)

offices.president: Electors for President and Vice President: tables of county rows with one column per elector, one table per party; name is the elector's name and party the party printed over the electors
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress (Congressional Candidates, Sixty-third or Sixty-fourth Congress), one table per congressional district; district is the district number. A table for the Sixty-third Congress printed in a 1914 volume is a special election
